title: Amazing!!
text: Danny was amazing!!! Will do again when we return

title: Tapas with Daniel
text: Daniel was great! We learned so much about the culture in our short time. Tapas were wonderful! the Mushrooms were my favorite. He was patient with our group and made several recommendations for the remainder of our trip. Would personally request him again!
author: E3363WMct

title: Excellent Tour & Guide
text: We really enjoyed this tour with Pablo.  I was a little hesitant upon first meeting Pablo, but he turned out to be a boisterous and enthusiastic tour guide.  We had our group of 5 and were joined by 2 more people.  It was a good sized group for this tour.  The flamenco dance was first on the agenda, not last, but that might have been a better itinerary.  My adult kids loved the show; my fiancé and I thought it was a little hokie, but still fun. author: kad9271

title: Pablo! Pablo!
text:
My husband and I were on our honeymoon and spent a few days in Barcelona.  Our tour with Pablo was an awesome experience.  The sites that he took us to, the flamenco show, and the tapas that we had were perfect.  
Pablo is so knowledgeable, speaks perfect English (thankfully for us) and is a pleasure to spend time with.
author: J4895JJjoyl

title: Sooooo FUN!!!
text:
If you’re looking for an authentic and unforgettable night in Barcelona, this is the tour to book! Pablo was an incredible guide—funny, friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about the city’s history, food, and culture. From the moment we met, he made everyone feel welcome and kept the experience fun and engaging.
The tapas stops were fantastic, with delicious local dishes and drinks that gave us a true taste of Barcelona. Pablo made each one of us feel so special.
The evening included a flamenco performance we will always remember.

title: Spanish Jack Black!
text:
Pablo — or as we affectionately called him, “Spanish Jack Black” — was absolutely amazing! He brought such a unique perspective to Spanish culture and the history of Spain, making every moment engaging, entertaining, and informative.

The entire experience was fantastic. We enjoyed an incredible flamenco show, a delicious tapas dinner at a wonderful restaurant, and a fascinating tour through several neighborhoods while learning about Spain’s rich history and traditions.

author: ryanhL1176AE

title: Barcelona walk, Flamenco & Tapas
text:
The experience was fantastic. Pablo is a very lively person. He made sure we had lots of fun memories during the walk. He took pictures and made collages with them. 
Loved the ambience and the history of the town. We enjoyed the Tapas as Pablo explained what they were. 
The Flamenco show was okay. Could have been better.
author: JoelW54

title: Insightful visit to historical Barcelona
text: Pablo was our tour guide thru the gothic quarter for tapas and flamenco.  He was engaging and fun.  Pablo was very knowable and a proud Catalan.  He leaned into our love of history and gave us a deep, insightful tour.  We would highly recommend.
author: Jules2od

title: 10/10 - Amazing Pablo
text: Pablo was an amazing guide and made everything feel special. From the show to the walking tour and of course Tapas, he was knowledgeable, friendly, and very funny. The tour was very informational and the food we tried was the best on our entire trip. Highly recommend this to anyone coming to Barcelona.
author: austinhK4878WA

title: Tapas and Flamenco
text: Pablo was very informative on our tour.  We enjoyed all of the personal attention!  Tapas and Flamenco show were both great.
